title: PSG-D4: four-level robust records with complete online generation

claims.statement: For every integer N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ, put n=ceil(log2 N). Use the ONE PSG-D4 algorithm and all four required proofs psg_depth_four.md, psg_depth_four_base.md, psg_depth_four_compiler.md, psg_depth_four_family.md. The actual program fixes d=4,C_4=7,n_4=2^256. The n>=2^256 branch uses the exact first-feasible four-level constant-gap profile, q0=(2R+1)^4,Qroot=7168q0,Wroot=8192*2^R,K=2^17n in every odd and multi-bit2-adic stage,Proot=7168n^4,Hmax=8192K=2^30n. The n<2^256 branch uses mF=2^20(n+16),the separate old finite EXTRACT precision P_label_old=2^40n^4,and the explicit exact N-candidate scan. Both branches pad actual acquisition to exactly Q=7*2^40n^5=7696581394432n^5. The selected full online controller is the complete literal compiler. For every adversary in claim5's exact adaptive model,including no corruption,it outputs the entire s with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8>2/3. All five claims and all four bounds hold jointly on every execution branch,including failed/neutral roots,retries,discarded copies,malformed inputs,numerical errors and all padding. Constants are absolute and independent of N,s,the adversary and outcomes. Worst-case total charged sequential work is T=O(n^(9/2)log2(n+2)2^(n/8)), equivalent asymptotically to the structured log2 n representative. It counts every classical bit operation,raw source cost n+1,precision,exact gate and inverse,circuit/address generation,tape/head/marker action,indexed access,initialization,measurement,reset,counter and failed work. Its exact growth index is1.

For the SAME PSG-D4 program and all four required proofs psg_depth_four.md,psg_depth_four_base.md,psg_depth_four_compiler.md,psg_depth_four_family.md,for every N>=2,every s in Z/NZ and every adversary in the exact structured adaptive model,the fraction epsilon(n)=1/(60129542144n^4)=1/(7*2^33n^4) is tolerated among all Q=7696581394432n^5=7*2^40n^5 actual acquired copies. The implied branchwise bad-copy cap is floor(epsilon(n)Q)=128n. Under this promise unconditional entire-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least1-2^-8>2/3 jointly with all four every-branch resource bounds in claims1--4. The clean adversary is included. Both the literal finite branch n<2^256 and the actual four-level main branch n>=2^256 are proved,so there is no validity threshold. This fraction is not an independent per-copy fault rate. No maximal fraction is asserted.

structured.error_model: Adaptive malformed-copy model with fraction epsilon(n). Parameters: N >= 2 is the modulus, s in Z/NZ the secret, n = ceil(log2 N), Q the total number of source copies the algorithm acquires, and epsilon(n) the tolerated malformed fraction. Copies are delivered one at a time in acquisition order j = 1, ..., Q. Before copy j is delivered, an adversary that knows N, s, the full description of the algorithm, and every measurement outcome the algorithm obtained before copy j is delivered, and that may hold, process and measure an arbitrary private quantum system, decides adaptively whether copy j is malformed; on every execution branch at most floor(epsilon(n) Q) of the Q acquired copies are malformed. A malformed copy is an arbitrary (n+1)-qubit state (the register shape of an ideal copy) supplied from the adversary's system: it may be pure or mixed, may be entangled with the adversary's remaining system and with other malformed copies, and may depend on all of the information above; it is not entangled with clean copies or with the algorithm's workspace, ancillas or internal random bits. Every copy that is not malformed is clean: at the moment of its delivery, a fresh ideal coset state rho_s = (1/N) sum_x |psi_{x,s}><psi_{x,s}| in tensor product with everything else (the adversary's system, all other copies and the algorithm's workspace), i.e. clean copies are independent ideal coset states. The adversary interacts with the algorithm only by supplying copies; after delivery it has no access to the copy or to the algorithm's quantum or classical systems. All measurements have countably many outcomes. The algorithm is not told which copies are malformed. Quantifiers: the guarantee must hold for every N >= 2 (no validity threshold), every s in Z/NZ and every such adversary, including the adversary that corrupts nothing (the clean problem): the algorithm outputs the entire s with probability at least 2/3, and the four declared resource bounds hold on every execution branch. The fraction bounds the number of malformed copies among acquired copies; it is not a per-copy corruption probability.
